comment: KOTOR III (fan) Citadel Station docks. Brannick, a retired spacer, points the crew toward Nar Shaddaa. Original writing for this fan project.

entries.text: You're the one walking with the Vaux girl. Heard her shuttle got topped up this morning. Wherever she's taking you, I hope you packed warmer than she did.
I'm counting ships, spacer, not making friends. Go and bother somebody who has a schedule.
Past the charts? Nobody on Telos sells routes like that. On Nar Shaddaa they trade them like any other cargo. The Mandalorian clans flew a few of those lanes once, in my day.
Brannick. Thirty years hauling ore and passengers in and out of this system. These days I sit on this crate and watch younger fools leave.
Somebody who still remembers the old clan lanes, if you can find one sober. Start at the refugee landing pad. And keep one hand on your credit chip.
Don't thank me. Just fly far enough for an old man who never got the chance.

replies.text: We need a route that goes beyond the star charts.
Thirty years. Then you might know a route past the charts.
Who on Nar Shaddaa would sell one?
